description: Different assignments of sides cannot both extend to the same ultrafilter.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.IndependentFamilies.distinct_assignments_no_common_extension.{u} {α : Type u} (A : Set (Set α))
  (ε δ : ↑A → Bool) (hne : ε ≠ δ) :
  ¬∃ U,
      Lemmatheca.SetTheory.IndependentFamilies.sideChoices A ε ⊆ (↑U).sets ∧
        Lemmatheca.SetTheory.IndependentFamilies.sideChoices A δ ⊆ (↑U).sets
